description: This file defines the PredefinedShelfService class, which manages predefined book shelves within a book tracking application. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, and populating predefined shelves and associated books, specifically for logged-in users. It also contains methods for initializing test data and utility functions for handling shelf names.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfService
classes.description: Service class managing predefined shelves and associated book operations, specifically tailored for logged-in users, including data population, retrieval, and utility functions related to shelf management.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a predefined shelf by its ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a predefined shelf.

methods.name: findAllForLoggedInUser
methods.description: Fetches all predefined shelves associated with the currently logged-in user.

methods.name: findToReadShelf
methods.description: Returns the 'To Read' shelf for the logged-in user.

methods.name: findReadingShelf
methods.description: Returns the 'Reading' shelf for the logged-in user.

methods.name: findReadShelf
methods.description: Returns the 'Read' shelf for the logged-in user.

methods.name: findDidNotFinishShelf
methods.description: Returns the 'Did not finish' shelf for the logged-in user.

methods.name: findByPredefinedShelfNameAndLoggedInUser
methods.description: Finds a predefined shelf by name and current user.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of predefined shelves.

methods.name: populateTestData
methods.description: Populates repositories with test data if empty, including authors, tags, publishers, shelves, and books, invoked after bean initialization.

methods.name: populateAuthorRepository
methods.description: Populates the author repository with generated author data.

methods.name: populateTagRepository
methods.description: Populates the tag repository with generated tags.

methods.name: populatePublisherRepository
methods.description: Populates the publisher repository with generated publishers.

methods.name: populateShelfRepository
methods.description: Creates default predefined shelves for a user.

methods.name: populateBookRepository
methods.description: Generates and saves books associated with predefined shelves.

methods.name: setShelfForEveryBookInBookRepository
methods.description: Assigns predefined shelves to all books in the repository.

methods.name: createPredefinedShelves
methods.description: Creates a list of predefined shelves for a given user.

methods.name: getPredefinedShelfByNameAsString
methods.description: Retrieves a predefined shelf by string name for the logged-in user.

methods.name: getPredefinedShelfByPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Gets predefined shelf by enum name for current user.

methods.name: getBooksInChosenPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Returns books within a specific shelf or all shelves based on input string.

methods.name: isAllBooksShelf
methods.description: Checks if the provided shelf name equals 'All books'.

methods.name: getBooksInAllPredefinedShelves
methods.description: Returns books from all predefined shelves for current user.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all predefined shelves.

methods.name: getBooksInPredefinedShelves
methods.description: Collects books from a list of predefined shelves.

methods.name: isPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Checks if a given string matches any predefined shelf name.

methods.name: getPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Converts a string to its corresponding ShelfName enum, if any.
